gate_results.evidence: Eight frozen S5 charter, source, and readiness-v28 artifacts are hash-bound.
The canonical public Bitcoin Core Git remote and master branch are fixed.
The source cutoff and v30.0 tag object identities were frozen before history access.
Exactly one credential-free, noninteractive Git clone process must execute.
The resulting repository must be bare with only master and zero local tag refs.
Pre-run free disk and the two-gigabyte dataset ceiling must both pass.
The clone must complete and move atomically to the frozen final dataset path.
The frozen source cutoff commit must exist and be an ancestor of fetched master.
The repository must report complete, non-shallow history.
Origin must be canonical and Git must preserve promisor plus blob:none filter metadata.
Every regular dataset file must be hashed into a complete deterministic manifest.
Only opaque cutoff-reachable object IDs and a commit count may be integrity-hashed.
The protocol permits zero market values, parameters, returns, candidates, and orders.
A PASS can authorize only a separately frozen completeness-census protocol.

limitations: A PASS authorizes only a separately frozen history-completeness census protocol.
A newer fetched master, when present, was acquired incidentally and is barred from analysis after the frozen cutoff.
Commit counts and object identifiers were used only for integrity and are nonqualifying.
Git transport success does not prove GitHub REST capacity for pull-request metadata.
No BTC market value, return, candidate, signal, paper order, Testnet strategy order, production action, live action, real capital, or profit was created.
No commit message, author identity, author timestamp, or pull-request identifier was read.
No predictive relationship, strategy, or profitable edge was tested or established.
Partial clone integrity does not imply historical point-in-time availability of later pull-request metadata.
The blob:none filter minimizes file payloads but does not remove commit or tree topology.
The dataset cannot be used for parameter selection, signal construction, or market comparison at this stage.
The public repository can change after acquisition; frozen hashes preserve the exact local payload received.
This result establishes only canonical Git payload acquisition and integrity.
